caption:
A trip to the Dolomites can be so much more than one famous viewpoint. 🇮🇹

Imagine mornings beside turquoise lakes, drives beneath huge limestone peaks, quiet alpine villages and hiking trails that open up into enormous mountain views.

This collection crosses several parts of the Italian Dolomites, from Val Gardena and Val di Funes to Lake Braies and Tre Cime. To actually enjoy it, choose one or two bases and give the different areas proper time instead of trying to see everything in a day.

Some mountain lifts, parking and access arrangements are seasonal, so build your route around the dates you're travelling.

Save these six scenes for your future mountain escape. 🗺️

Photography: Finge Holden, Andrei R. Popescu, Alan Jiang, Pascal Debrunner & Luka Verč / Unsplash.
